{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]  # Remove QC-failure sentinels

df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates('patient_id', keep='first')  # Deduplicate on patient_id, keep highest sample_seq

# Now check the final shape and baseline vs final biomarker
df['biomarker_change'] = df['biomarker_final'] - df['biomarker_baseline']

df['biomarker_final_corrected'] = df['biomarker_final']
df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] = df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Final baseline and final biomarker (corrected for batch B)
baseline_mean = df['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
final_mean_corrected = df['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()

print(f'Final dataset size: {len(df)} patients')
print(f'Baseline biomarker mean: {baseline_mean:.2f} ng/mL')
print(f'Final biomarker mean (corrected): {final_mean_corrected:.2f} ng/mL')
print(f'Change in biomarker: {final_mean_corrected - baseline_mean:.2f} ng/mL')"}
